_doc: Registry of the CG project (CG, master index). A SUBSET of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json, narrowed to the CG family. Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container — see clone.sh for the clone/link model. Private members are linked only: the index exposes their name, never their content.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: CG-circus
repos.doc: Sources of the c_Circus group (movies, music, myfeed moved to cloud-webapps-2, #1204), split from front-projects (#1072); snapshot copy, paths mirror the original layout.

repos.name: CG-galaxy
repos.doc: Sources of the b_Projects group, split from front-projects (#1072); snapshot copy, paths mirror the original layout.

repos.name: CG-unity
repos.doc: Unity asset pipeline (unity-asset-vm: upkg2gltf, fetch-and-convert) plus its assets. Was front-asset-cdn, the predecessor of front-assets-cdn; renamed 2026-08-18 to match what it actually holds - the CDN itself is front-assets-cdn.

repos.name: CG-voxel-rust
repos.doc: Voxel engine in Rust (vox-rust build plan under docs/).

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field — every CG-* repo links at the root of this index, same as front.
